# HeatEquationKernel demo: a CPU heat-equation solver whose temperature-dependent
# material properties are generated by MaterForge. The shared waLBerla build, MPI,
# and the sweepgen venv are provided by the top-level apps/CMakeLists.txt.

add_executable(HeatEquationWithMaterial)
target_sources(HeatEquationWithMaterial PRIVATE CodegenHeatEquationWithMaterial.cpp)
target_link_libraries(HeatEquationWithMaterial PRIVATE
    walberla::blockforest walberla::core walberla::field walberla::stencil
    walberla::timeloop walberla::vtk walberla::pde MPI::MPI_CXX)

walberla_generate_sources(HeatEquationWithMaterial
    SCRIPTS HeatEquationKernelWithMaterial.py
    FILE_EXTENSIONS .cpp .hpp)
